description: Ministry of Defence - The award of the Armed Services Long Service Medal to the persons - The award of the Armed Services Long Service Clasp to the persons
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the award of the Sri Lanka Armed Services Long Service Medal to military personnel. This falls under public service matters as it deals with service recognition and awards for members of the armed forces, which is a public sector service administration function. The content does not involve government structural changes, personnel appointments with detailed portfolios, or any of the other specialized categories like land, legal, commercial, elections, or judicial matters.
